Compare shared controls with provider-native ones on integration effort, operating cost and assurance gaps, separate what is verified from what is assumed, and recommend whether to adopt, change the design or hold scope. - Lead the technical assessment of production readiness. Review recovery, containment and fault-exercise evidence, and give the programme lead a clear view of what is ready and what is not. - Stay with the platform through go-live and the support period after it. Resolve the architectural issues that production exposes, and decide when a fix is a design change rather than a defect. - Prepare the client's receiving engineers to maintain the design. Lead the architecture part

description: Description Senior Systems Engineer - Autonomy Behavior The Role As a Senior Autonomy Behavior Systems Engineer, you will help define and validate how an autonomous vehicle behaves in the real world. You will own one or more behavior areas from requirements through simulation evaluation, road-data review, and release recommendation. Strong understanding of systems engineering fundamentals, including system decomposition, use-case definition, requirements authoring, interface definition, verification planning, and traceability. Professional experience designing or executing simulation-based evaluations at scale, not just isolated scenario demonstrations. Strong Python experience for data analysis, test automation, simulation workflows, and engineering tools and exposure to agentic workflows. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of working effectively across teams. Demonstrated ability to manage stakeholders, resolve ambiguity, set expectations, and drive work to completion without waiting for a perfect process.
